verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, a hardware accelerator rather than a software tool with an interactive mode, so headless or CI operation is not a meaningful axis for this kind of product. The evidence covers the separate Brev CLI (`brev create`) and NGC containers, which are distinct ecosystem products. Nothing shows the H200 itself shipping a headless or CI automation capability, so the axis stays a category error.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
